decision: repair_v5 is adopted as the working version of the pipeline, and ANCHOR_PRIOR_MODE=kriging as the WP3 extinction prior method.

adopted: repair_v5 as the working chain for WP3, WP4 and WP5 products
NOT_adopted: WP5 acceptance — the gate is still not passed
the replacement trend statistic — still fails its own R3 criterion
scope_of_the_decision.clarification: Adopting the extinction method is not the same as passing the WP5 gate. Under the strict per-branch reading of G3, repair_v5 still fails on three A/C non-baseline cells, so WP6 stays unauthorized.

what_the_decision_rests_on.principle: The anchor prior contained an internal contradiction: prior_sigma_at widened the width toward the sill as anchors became distant (declaring them uninformative) while evaluate() still took those same anchors' median at full weight.  Simple kriging with the SAME already-fitted variogram removes the contradiction and introduces no new parameter.
what_the_decision_rests_on.independent_support: both 3D dust cubes rank CygOB2-B as the LEAST extinguished subgroup (Vergely 3.378 vs A 3.685, C 3.763), while the uncorrected prior ranked it the MOST extinguished
what_the_decision_rests_on.selection_bias_ruled_out: anchors read +0.500 mag HIGHER than co-located members' photometry-only A_V (Wilcoxon p=4.3e-16), the opposite sign to the failure mode that would have mattered; provenance/wp3_kriging_downstream_impact.json
what_the_decision_rests_on.b_specificity_is_intrinsic: kriging weights sum to 1.000 (A), 0.992 (C), 0.772 (B), so the correction follows from anchor geometry and no per-subgroup choice was made

obligations_this_decision_creates.obligation: Report the revised star-formation history as a RESULT.  The age spread is unchanged (1.469 Myr) but CygOB2-B moves from near C to near A, so the association reads as two older subgroups plus one younger rather than one older plus two younger.  WP7's supernova timeline depends on this.

Carry the anchor absolute-scale systematic in the paper's budget: broadband photometry sits about 0.5 mag below spectroscopically calibrated anchors at matched sky position, so the absolute mass scale and hence N_SN inherit the anchor calibration.  Predates repair_v5 and is not introduced by it.
Carry the CygOB2-B calibration asymmetry: B still has only 4 spectroscopic anchors against A's 59 and C's 42.  Gaia XP spectra are the natural way to remove it (issue #1d).
Resolve issue #11's R3 criterion before WP5 can be accepted; two of the three remaining A/C regressions sit at trend p = 0.040 and 0.048, inside the indeterminate band.
